_note: Campus-wide facts from the team. Edit and re-run `npm run import`.
halalNote: All food outlets listed in APEats serve halal food (checked in person by the APEats team).
_hideItemsWithoutPhoto: true hides items without a photo from the app and the AI. Default false: they stay visible with a placeholder.
_brandNames: Small stall name under a cuisine; null hides it. Cuisines not listed use the name on the menu board.
_coverPhotos: Optional cover photo of a cuisine (a file name in public/photos without .jpg); otherwise one is picked automatically.
